title: When and Why Does Multi-Agent Debate Fail and Does It Really Underperform?
abstract: arXiv:2510.20963v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-agent debate (MAD) was proposed as a promising approach for ensembling the wisdom of multiple large language models (LLMs) to improve reasoning and provide effective supervision to superhuman LLMs. However, increasing empirical evidence suggests that MAD may not outperform or even underperform single-agent approaches (SA), raising doubts about the benefits of MAD. In this work, we investigate this issue by analyzing the incentive structures of popular MAD paradigms: (i) competitive MAD (CopMAD) where agents compete by holding opposing positions; (ii) consensus-seeking MAD (CosMAD) where agents are driven to seek consensus. We show that both paradigms suffer from debate hacking: CopMAD reduces to a cheap-talk game, where agents produce misleading messages to win the game, while CosMAD filters out informative disagreements for premature consensus. translated_title: 多智能体辩论何时以及为何会失败？它真的表现更差吗？
translated_abstract: 多智能体辩论（MAD）被提出作为一种有前景的方法，用于汇聚多个大型语言模型（LLM）的智慧以提升推理能力，并为超越人类水平的LLM提供有效监督。然而，越来越多的实证证据表明，MAD可能并不优于甚至表现不如单智能体方法（SA），这引发了人们对MAD益处的质疑。在本工作中，我们通过分析流行的MAD范式的激励结构来研究这一问题：（i）竞争型MAD（CopMAD），其中智能体通过持相反立场进行竞争；（ii）寻求共识型MAD（CosMAD），其中智能体被驱动去寻求共识。我们证明这两种范式都存在“辩论作弊”问题：CopMAD退化为一种“空谈博弈”，智能体为赢得博弈而产出误导性信息；而CosMAD则过滤掉有信息量的分歧以达成过早的共识。因此，CopMAD和CosMAD中的智能体都无法共同解决歧义……
tldr: 该论文通过分析竞争型与共识型两种多智能体辩论范式的激励结构，揭示二者均因“辩论作弊”机制（空谈博弈或过早共识）而失效，从而解释了多智能体辩论为何常不如单智能体方法。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes the incentive structures of competitive and consensus-seeking multi-agent debate paradigms, revealing that both suffer from "debate hacking" — degenerating into cheap-talk games or premature consensus — which explains why MAD often underperforms single-agent approaches.
